body: Pinaka-useful na boundary dito: after an investment loss, gumawa ng hard rule na zero additional payment for any unsolicited 'recovery' offer until verified through an independently found official channel and reviewed by another person with no financial stake. Hindi nito sinasabing impossible ang legitimate restitution; hinihiwalay lang nito ang hope sa payment decision. Kapag may urgency, secrecy, o kailangan munang mag-invest ulit para ma-release ang refund, iyon ang moment to slow down, not speed up.
